headline: Millersville's defence sets them apart at the top
dek: Millersville followed their win at Shepherd with another over West Chester on Wednesday, and have conceded four goals in seven matches, as few as any side in the conference has let in. Only Slippery Rock have kept the figure that low, and they have played fewer matches to do it.
displaced_by: Millersville beat West Chester on 2026-09-16 for a second conference win, four conceded in seven matches
